name: Murauen Warm-up
reason: A flat southern escape with long stretches near the Mur and an easy rhythm from the door.
compromise: Urban cycle connections at the beginning and end

name: Thalersee Bogen
reason: A compact western loop for a weekday spin, with Thalersee as the middle punctuation mark.
reward: Thalersee and rolling lanes west of Graz
compromise: A few busier kilometres while leaving the city

name: Laßnitzhöhe Roller
reason: A rolling eastern road loop with a real hilltop feeling and a relaxed southern return.
compromise: Repeated rollers make it harder than its distance suggests

name: Radegund Balcony
reason: A northern climbing loop with a sustained reward above the city and a flowing return through Kumberg.
reward: The Radegund climb and broad views
compromise: Meaningful climbing and a lively approach through Graz

name: Semriach Quiet Side
reason: A proper northern loop that trades the direct road for quieter climbing and a long countryside middle.
compromise: Steady climbing with limited easy bail-outs

name: Wildon Fields
reason: A longer, mostly flat southern day with farm roads, a clear destination and room to settle in.
compromise: Wind exposure and longer urban connectors

name: Weiz via Radegund
reason: A big eastern circuit linking two distinct climbs with a long, purposeful day on the bike.
reward: Radegund, Weiz and the eastern ridges
compromise: A long exposed return if the wind turns

name: Stainz Westward
reason: A full west-and-south road day with a distant destination and a calmer homeward line.
compromise: Several necessary connecting roads and little shelter in places

name: Teichalm Grand Loop
reason: The home-door epic: a mountain plateau, a substantial day out and a return through familiar eastern hills.
compromise: A long, mountainous ride with weather exposure

name: Southeast Arc
reason: A broad southeastern arc for quiet farmland, rolling terrain and a satisfying return along the Mur side.
compromise: Sparse services on the outer half

name: West Ridges
reason: A hilly western circuit with quieter ridges and enough variation to feel like a small adventure.
compromise: Frequent gradient changes interrupt the rhythm
shortening: Cut across from Thal to Gratwein

name: Kumberg Figure Eight
reason: A medium-distance eastern figure eight that layers climbing without committing to a full mountain day.
reward: Two different approaches to the Kumberg hills
compromise: The central junction is ridden twice

name: Teichalm Plateau
reason: A focused mountain loop that spends its energy on the plateau rather than the transfer from Graz.
compromise: Weather can change quickly; seasonal conditions need checking
startLabel: Mixnitz area — verify parking before departure

name: Gaberl Pass Day
reason: A pass-centred climbing day with a clear summit and a compact mountain loop.
compromise: Mountain traffic and weather require a day-of check
startLabel: Köflach area — verify parking before departure

name: Soboth Border Roads
reason: A long southern mountain loop built around the remote roads and sustained climbing of Soboth.
reward: Reservoir, pass roads and border-country scale
startLabel: Eibiswald area — verify parking before departure

name: Wine Road Ridges
reason: A rolling destination ride where short climbs, vineyards and changing views matter more than one summit.
compromise: Tourist traffic and repeated steep ramps
startLabel: Ehrenhausen area — verify parking before departure
